name: hermretro-engine-build
description: Tools for building the engine bundle (engine/modretro-chromatic/dist/server.js) and comparing two bundles: esbuild at the version the engine was bundled with, the packages the bundle includes at the engine's locked versions (engine/modretro-chromatic/scripts/runtime-package-lock.json), and acorn and eslint-scope for the comparison. Never needed to use the plugin. Install with: npm ci --prefix tools/engine/npm --ignore-scripts
